not_fixed.why: Equivalent mutant. Inside the lock, recheck(row) refuses with 65 stale-epoch or wrong-step, and the next call, lib.updateRow with {epoch: E, steps: ['stop-requested']}, refuses the same row with the same exit and slugs (only the detail keys differ). In --dry-run the only possible difference is a race between two reads of the same file milliseconds apart in one process, and nothing can inject that. No seam was added to stop.mjs.

An observation, not a finding; left unchanged. admit, replace, stop and handover run main only when path.resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) equals path.resolve(process.argv[1]). Node gives the main module's import.meta.url as a realpath, but argv[1] is not resolved. So a script started through a junction or symlink would print nothing and exit 0. Comparing fs.realpathSync.native of both sides would close this; it should be one change across the unit.

tests.command: node tools/lane.mjs --label fix-U1-<file> --timeout-s 300 -- node --test --test-concurrency=1 tcb/test/<file>.test.mjs, one lane call per file (replace, admit, stop, watch, status, handover), cwd tcb-build. Mutations ran through review-tmp/fix-U1/mut2.sh, one lane call each, with the script restored and checked by cmp after each.
tests.output_tail: replace 80: 78 pass, 2 skipped (88.6 s, rerun after the new R4 test). admit 38: 36 pass, 2 skipped (50.1 s). stop 39: 36 pass, 3 skipped (51.4 s). watch 69: 65 pass, 4 skipped (72.1 s). status 32: 30 pass, 2 skipped (145.4 s). handover 22: 19 pass, 3 skipped (46.6 s). Every skip is an app-only NA test. Every mutation fails its tests: A5, A7, W3, W8, no-fresh, mayRun=false, no-timeout, timeout-unreported, R2, H4, ST6, R4. On the two timeouts before the stop: fix-U1-full-admit-stop hung in stop T2b's second subtest, which spawns a sleeper and reads process lists through PowerShell Get-CimInstance. fix-U2, running at the same time (the lane allows 2), timed out 40 s earlier. Run alone now, admit takes 50 s, stop 51 s and T2b 7.4 s. Both timeouts fall in the minutes of the session stop, so the likely cause is a system-wide WMI/PowerShell stall, not a hanging test.

Not lib: after U1-F5, the stop of a fenced attempt that has a manifest but no visible session needs watcher ticks (run/watcher.json) before verify can confirm it.
